meta.title: Phase 6 Fix: Fix directions for defects found in review

architecture_notes: These fix directions address defects found during the make-judgement review of phase-6-fix. Two P1 runtime bugs in scf_dos_chain, one missing HubbardUUnit import in multi_param_sweep, one unused dependency, one architecture note discrepancy, and G3-1 workspace cleanup.
known_pitfalls: Fix order: Apply P1 fixes first (functional correctness), then P2/P3 fixes (cleanup). G3-1 should run last since it modifies workspace-wide state.

task_groups.reason: Fix 6 defects found during make-judgement review of phase-6-fix.
Execute G3-1 workspace cleanup that was not yet performed.

tasks.description: Fix SCF task job script using wrong task_id in scf_dos_chain/src/main.rs. The first argument to generate_job_script should be "scf", not &seed_name.

changes.guidance: Change the SCF setup closure's generate_job_script call from generate_job_script(config, &seed_name, &seed_name) to generate_job_script(config, "scf", &seed_name). The first parameter is the task_id for the SBATCH --job-name directive, which should be "scf" to match the task ID.

tasks.description: Fix DOS collect closure ignoring workdir path in scf_dos_chain/src/main.rs. The collect closure must use the path argument to join the output filename.

changes.guidance: Change the DOS collect closure: replace |_: &Path| with |path: &Path| and replace PathBuf::from("ZnO_DOS.castep") with path.join("ZnO_DOS.castep"). This matches the SCF collect pattern which correctly uses the workdir path argument.

tasks.description: Add HubbardUUnit import and .unit() call in multi_param_sweep/src/main.rs. The HubbardU builder must include .unit(HubbardUUnit::ElectronVolt) for correctness.

changes.guidance: Add HubbardUUnit to the import from castep_cell_io::cell::species: change the import to include HubbardUUnit alongside the existing AtomHubbardU, HubbardU, OrbitalU, Species. Add .unit(HubbardUUnit::ElectronVolt) to the HubbardU::builder() chain before .atom_u_values(). The correct chain is: HubbardU::builder().unit(HubbardUUnit::ElectronVolt).atom_u_values(vec![atom_u]).build()

tasks.description: Remove unused itertools dependency from scf_dos_chain/Cargo.toml.

changes.guidance: Remove the line 'itertools = { workspace = true }' from [dependencies] in scf_dos_chain/Cargo.toml. itertools is not imported or used in any scf_dos_chain source file.

acceptance: cargo check -p scf_dos_chain (must compile without itertools)
cargo test -p scf_dos_chain (all tests must pass)

tasks.description: Update architecture notes to acknowledge workflow_core/src/task.rs changes, or revert the changes.

changes.guidance: Update architecture_notes item 14: change 'no_new_library_crates: No new library crates are created' to acknowledge the TaskClosure type alias was added to workflow_core/src/task.rs. Accept the TaskClosure alias and manual Debug impl as necessary enablers for the binary crates. If desired, revert the changes to task.rs and inline the closure type in both binaries.

tasks.description: Document the castep-cell-fmt path dep deviation in hubbard_u_sweep/Cargo.toml.

changes.guidance: No code change needed — the path dep was likely necessary for Cargo resolution with the local castep-cell-io dependency. Verify with cargo check -p hubbard_u_sweep that it compiles. If it compiles, document this as an intentional deviation.

tasks.description: Execute G3-1 workspace cleanup: remove hubbard_u_sweep_slurm from workspace members and delete the directory.

changes.guidance: Remove 'examples/hubbard_u_sweep_slurm' from the [workspace] members array. The members list should contain exactly: 'workflow_core', 'workflow_utils', 'examples/hubbard_u_sweep', 'examples/multi_param_sweep', 'examples/scf_dos_chain', 'workflow-cli'. Do NOT change any other configuration.
Delete the entire examples/hubbard_u_sweep_slurm/ directory and all contents.

acceptance: cargo build --workspace (all crates compile with zero errors, zero warnings)
cargo run --bin multi_param_sweep -- --dry-run (produces correct topological order with 6 default tasks)
ls examples/hubbard_u_sweep_slurm/ 2>&1 | grep -q 'No such file' || false
